headline: Iran threatens wider strikes on ECONOMIC and CIVILIAN targets in the Gulf if US attacks
dek: If the US and Israel restart their air campaign, Iran will respond with strikes not only on US bases and warships but on airports, pipelines and other civilian targets in neighboring Persian Gulf countries.
